Done. The falsifier came out **negative for the blit** — "not the blit" is not refuted, and it is now a device measurement.

**Provenance, dated before any number was used**

| | arm A | arm B |
|---|---|---|
| ref / apk_sha | `71c7bd1d7d` / `7064ef90460a` | `24a75d6e3c` / `dc3dc7c38b55` |
| device | thor `bdc158a5` | thor `bdc158a5` |
| captures written | 2026-09-18 12:12–12:21 | 2026-09-18 12:23–12:32 |
| runs | 5, all proven | 5, all proven |

Goldens are 2026-09-09 — nine days *older* than the run, so no golden-newer-than-run hazard. `dca3c94b98` is 2026-09-12 and verified an ancestor of **both** refs (and not of the desktop `b9d845d316`). I hashed both APKs to confirm the `apk_sha` on every scored row is the binary built from that ref — two distinct binaries, not one column repeated.

**Result**

- **0 of 8 blitted destination pixels differ.** All eight are `(255,255,0,255)` against `(255,255,0,255)`.
- The single differing pixel is at **(176,180)**, B channel only, ours 227 / golden 228. Same pixel, same channel, same value in all eight captures across all ten runs of both arms — while the blit destination takes eight different coordinates. Its offset from the blit dest ranges from (−16,−11) to (+113,+116), so it is nailed to the geometry, not to the copy.
- It is one displaced quantisation step edge on a colour ramp: the golden steps B 227→228 at x=176, we step at x=177. One of 7,301 B-channel step edges in the quad. The x=64 R tie the desktop write-up named is closed on device at this ref.
- All seven `ImgBlt_Clip_*` and `BlitBeyondWidth` read 0 on device too, so the first pass's desktop refutation holds on hardware.

**De-confound, with what remains.** Device at `ccad2844d4` (no `dca3c94b98`): 1,573 px. Device at both arm refs: 1 px. Desktop-vs-device is gone. I did **not** attribute the drop to `dca3c94b98` — Nova→Thor is a device change and the window demonstrably carries blit work (`BlitBeyondWidth` 284,628→0 across it). #83 needed the coordinate, not the attribution.

**Recommendation: CLOSE #83.** The surviving pixel already has an open owner — **#38**, `fixed-part`, mechanism 1 (vertex colour quantised before the interpolator, `glsl/vsh.c` + `dca3c94b98`). No re-file, no file grant.

Comment posted ([#83 comment 5737991240](https://github.com/jreinach-alt/hakuX/issues/83#issuecomment-5737991240)), board request dropped at `$DISPATCH_DIR/board-requests/lane.blit83b.md`, draft PR #104 open with `NOTES.md` as the entire diff. Nothing under `hw/`.
